Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:27292
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 45792 of 2023

Applicant :- Sohan Lal @ Sonu
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Singh Rajput,Raj Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Raj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra, learned brief holder for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 119 of 2023, under sections 306, 498-A I.P.C., Police Station Sirsakalar, District Jalaun, during pendency of the trial.

3. F.I.R. of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members under sections 302/34 I.P.C. and according to the F.I.R. marriage of the sister of the informant was performed with the applicant about 14 years before and applicant was having illicit relationship with some other lady and due to this reason applicant and his family members tortured the deceased and in the intervening night of 11/12.06.2023 they have committed her murder.
It is further mentioned in the F.I.R. that after the incident applicant informed the informant that due to electricity shock the deceased died.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is the husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation he has been made accused in the present matter.
He further submits that however F.I.R. of the present case was lodged under section 302/34 I.P.C. but during investigation case was converted under section 306, 498-A I.P.C.
He further submits that in the F.I.R. there is no demand of dowry and only allegation is that as applicant is having illicit relationship with some other lady, therefore, deceased committed suicide.
He further submits that during investigation no evidence in this regard has been collected by the investigating officer.
He further submits that it appears that wife of the applicant was having doubt about the character of the applicant and only due to this reason she committed suicide by hanging herself.
He further submits that post mortem report suggests that the deceased died due to hanging.

5. He further submits that even if due to the love affair of the husband his wife committed suicide then her husband cannot be held for offence under section 306 I.P.C. as it cannot be said that due to abetment of the husband she committed suicide.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail since 16.06.2023.

6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and due to his illicit relationship she committed suicide, therefore, it cannot be said that there is no evidence of abetment against the applicant 7.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. From the record it reflects that initially F.I.R. of the present case was lodged under section 302/34 I.P.C. but during investigation case was converted under section 306/498A I.P.C. and as per the prosecution applicant who is husband of the deceased was having illicit relationship with some other lady and due to this reason the deceased committed suicide but during investigation investigating officer did not collect any evidence in this regard and, therefore, arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that it appears deceased was having suspicion that applicant was having illicit relationship with some other lady, therefore, she committed suicide cannot be ruled out.
Further applicant is not having any criminal history and is in jail since 16.06.2023.

9. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant -Sohan Lal @ Sonu be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

13. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
